reply_text: @Tobias Rendle, the depot is **Southgate**. In the 3 Sep 2025 incident, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She later confirmed that labels were printing again and that Southgate had cleared the backlog. That incident is from last year, so check it's the outage you're thinking of before you quote it on the call.
